title: Transfer learning-enabled outcome prediction for guiding CRRT treatment of the pediatric patients with sepsis.
summary: MIMIC-III CRRT mortality model and pediatric transfer comparison are reported; evidence supports outcome prediction among treated patients, not causal identification of who benefits from CRRT.
ai_technology: 4,161 CRRT-treated septic patients; XGBoost AUC .61 before c-GAN augmentation and .78 after; pediatric 200-patient transfer cohort AUC .76 vs .62 direct model. No untreated comparison, so “benefit” wording is not causal proof.
organization: Not stated in the abstract reviewed

evidence.unknown: The result is limited to the reported study population, data and evaluation; broader generalization or real-world benefit was not established.
